excerpts.text: The men's [giant slalom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giant_slalom "Giant slalom") competition of the [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpine_skiing_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics "Alpine skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics") was held on Saturday, 14 February, at [Stelvio Ski Centre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stelvio_(ski_course) "Stelvio (ski course)") in [Bormio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bormio "Bormio").[[1]](#cite_note-schedule-1) [Lucas Pinheiro Braathen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucas_Pinheiro_Braathen "Lucas Pinheiro Braathen") of Brazil won the event.
